comparison.objective: Join two boards evenly on three dowels; candidate commissions an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually align three simultaneous pin/socket pairs and press without wedging versus precision tool insertion, collar adjustment, relocking, and test iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Board seam fully seated, flush, flat, and released versus two non-bottoming stops with bounded forces and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Multi-pin insertion and even seating do not test adjustable energy absorption.
